messages.subject: Workshops to learn R this Fall
messages.subject_clean: Workshops to learn R this Fall
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies,
You have several opportunities this fall to learn more about using R in your research! The Datalab is offering the following workshops during fall quarter:

- Introduction to Reproducible and Collaborative Research Practices with R <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-reproducible-and-collaborative-research-practices-with-r/> - September 20-22 (https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-reproducible-and-collaborative-research-practices-with-r/)
- Introduction to Regression in R <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-regression-in-r-part-1-of-2/> - November 9 and November 16 (https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/introduction-to-regression-in-r-part-1-of-2/)
- InstallFest 2023 <https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/installfest-2023/> - October 5 (https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/eventscalendar/installfest-2023/)

Click the links to learn more, or look over the complete list of workshops here: https://datalab.ucdavis.edu/workshops/

-Wes

See you this afternoon!
